description: Public, transferable relay config artifact. Carries only operator-supplied endpoint metadata (public URL, relay name, schema/init versions) so a client can be pointed at the relay. NEVER carries a bearer token, certificate, private key, or fingerprint (the token lives separately in the mode-0600 relay-token file; the relay generates no certificates). Written only when RELAY_PUBLIC_URL is set; without it, users enter the server endpoint manually. The init implementation (deploy/sync-relay/relay-init.mjs) remains the authoritative validator: it enforces exact keys, exact primitive types, http/https publicUrl, and RFC3339 date-time issuedAt with calendar validity.

publicUrl.description: Operator-supplied relay endpoint (http:// for direct LAN access, https:// when the deployment provides TLS). Users enter this as the client endpoint.

relayInitVersion.description: Init-contract version that produced this artifact.

relayName.description: Relay display name (1-128 characters, enforced before write).

schemaVersion.description: Public config schema version. Bump on any incompatible field change.

title: Cherry Chat relay public config (relay-config.cherry)
